name: Nippon Concrete Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Concrete Industries Co., Ltd. makes, installs and distributes prefabricated concrete products. They include concrete and NC poles used for electric railroads, power lines, telecommunication networks and mobile phone base stations, as well as poles supporting lighting, sports nets and disaster radio systems. It operates in Japan, Myanmar, Vietnam, Thailand and Indonesia. Dating from 1948, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
